name: labs/mattjax16__rigol-dho-mcp
title: Rigol DHO oscilloscope through rigol-dho-mcp (controlled MCP contract)
intro: Rigol DHO oscilloscope through rigol-dho-mcp (controlled MCP contract), adapted from mattjax16/rigol-dho-mcp. It reads `trigger_status`; runs `identify`, `get_status`, `run_control`, `configure_channel` and 12 more. `identify`: query the *IDN? identity string through the identify tool. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
